criteriaNotes.1_topdown_view: Correct: flat floor piece seen straight from above, no side faces, frame is a flush flat band. Hinges and ring are drawn flat on the lid plane. OK.
criteriaNotes.2_style_fit: Frame uses the warm grey stone ramp (A/L/C/B) with speckle like v5 floor stone; lid has a two-tone dark ramp, gold rim lit top-left/dark bottom-right, purple star with highlight. Matches the archive steles (black + purple). No flat fills, no noise. OK.
criteriaNotes.3_readability_1x: At 1x in the archive it reads as a heavy sealed stone lid with a star keyhole; hinges (two pale tabs on the north seam) and the south pull ring push it toward 'trapdoor'. Acceptable, though it is dark and the hinges are only just legible.
criteriaNotes.4_placement: Frame sits flush on the plank floor in the mockup, 2 transparent rows top / 1 bottom is not visible against the floor and matches the open-stair state; looks grounded. OK.
criteriaNotes.5_silhouette_outline: Square silhouette clean. Defect inside: the rune ring is broken. Only three rune dots exist: (9,22), (22,22) and (9,10). The top-right dot is missing - its slot (22,10) is overwritten by the right hinge strap tip. The top-left dot (9,10) sits directly under the left strap column (strap x8-9 rows 6-9, tip at (8,10)), so it reads as a purple stray pixel on the end of the iron strap, not as a rune. The ring is asymmetric and the left strap looks glitched.

items.name: 별 봉인 돌뚜껑(닫힘, 2×2) (star seal)
reasons: View, palette, placement and 1x read as a hinged lid with a star keyhole are fine; the only failing point is the rune dots colliding with the hinge straps.
Rune ring broken: only 3 of the claimed 4 diagonal dots exist. Top-right dot missing - (22,10) is the right strap tip (I).
Top-left rune M at (9,10) touches the left strap (column x9 rows 6-9 is strap I, tip at (8,10)) so the strap appears to end in a purple stray pixel.

FIX: keep the straps rows 6-10 as is and move both top rune dots clear of them and mirrored to the bottom pair: put M at (11,11) and (20,11) (both currently O; (10,11)/(21,11) would still touch the right strap tip at (22,10)), restore (9,10) to J. Alternatively shorten both straps to end at row 9 and place the top runes at (9,11)/(22,11) - either way no rune pixel may be 8-adjacent to a strap pixel and the four dots must be mirror-symmetric about x=15.5.
